initialExam.title: NABARD Grade B Officer 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
initialExam.description: NABARD Grade B recruitment for managers overseeing rural development banking and agricultural financing across India.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with 60% or Post-graduation with 55%
initialExam.syllabus: Phase I: English, Quant, Reasoning, GA, Economic & Social Issues. Phase II: Descriptive English, domain papers.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase I: 200 marks online. Phase II: 200 marks. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Phase I → Phase II → Interview → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Grade B Manager in NABARD for agricultural and rural development financing
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade B → DGM → GM → CGM → DMD → Chairman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit nabard.org 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, Pension, Housing loan, Rural posting allowance
